description.narrative: The programmatic approach supports the government's ongoing efforts to further enhance financial inclusion. It will (i) improve the government's capabilities to better target and track financial inclusion efforts and enhance supporting infrastructure; (ii) directly increase access to finance for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) and the underserved using innovative technology; and (iii) strengthen the regulatory framework for digital financial services, data privacy, and consumer protection.
